name: Zein Nile Chateau

seo.title: Zein Nile Chateau Dahabiya | A&K Private Nile Charter
seo.description: Zein Nile Chateau, an A&K Sanctuary: a six-cabin dahabiya for 12 guests, chartered privately between Luxor and Aswan or joined inside two A&K journeys.
keywords: Petra the Pyramids and a Nile Yacht Cruise

tagline: Six cabins under sail. The whole boat, if you want it.
answer: Zein Nile Chateau is A&K Sanctuary's smallest Nile vessel: a 50 m dahabiya with six cabins and suites for 12 guests, sailing between Luxor and Aswan. A&K sells her as a private charter with an itinerary built around you, and by the cabin inside two of its journeys. Children of all ages are welcome. She suits families and small groups who want the boat to themselves.
facts: 6 (4 Deluxe Cabins, Napoleon Suite, Farouk Suite)
Plunge pool on the sun deck
Cabins, bathrooms and lounge recently revamped (A&K gives no year)
Private charter, or by the cabin inside two A&K journeys
overview: Zein Nile Chateau is a dahabiya: wood-clad, long and low, with sails fore and aft, modelled on the boats that carried 19th-century travellers up the Nile. A&K calls her the first luxury dahabiya of the modern era and the smallest boat in its Sanctuary fleet. Six cabins, 12 guests.

Each cabin is named and finished differently, with bathrooms in Egyptian marble and stone: green stone in Lake Nasser, travertine in Baladi, red granite in Nubia, limestone in Philae. The Napoleon Suite has a four-poster; the Farouk Suite runs to 108 sq m with a private dining area and a Jacuzzi. Up top there is an Arabian-style sun deck with rugs and low tables, a plunge pool and shaded daybeds.

Her size lets her moor where the big riverboats cannot, including Gebel el-Silsila, the old quarry where the Nile runs narrowest. As a charter the route between Luxor and Aswan is yours to set with an Egyptologist. A&K also sells her cabins inside Petra, the Pyramids and a Nile Yacht Cruise, and Greece, Turkey and Egypt by Private Jet.
why: When a family or a group of friends wants Egypt without strangers at the next table, this is the boat. Six cabins fill easily, children of any age are allowed, and the itinerary bends to the group: an extra morning at Karnak, a stop at Gebel el-Silsila, lunch on a river island. For two travellers, the Petra and Pyramids journey is the simplest way aboard.

itineraries.name: Private charter, Luxor and Aswan
itineraries.direction: Luxor to Aswan or Aswan to Luxor

itineraries.name: 4-night Luxor to Aswan (inside Petra, the Pyramids and a Nile Yacht Cruise)

days.title: Karnak and Luxor Temple
days.summary: Fly to Luxor and walk the Great Hypostyle Hall at Karnak, then board for lunch. Afternoon at the Temple of Luxor and the Colonnade of Amenhotep III.

days.title: The Valley of the Kings
days.summary: The Valley of the Kings, including the tomb of Tutankhamun, and the Temple of Hatshepsut.

days.title: Edfu
days.summary: Cruise to the Temple of Horus at Edfu, then sail on toward Aswan with a sundowner on deck.

days.title: Kom Ombo, Philae and a felucca
days.summary: Stop at Kom Ombo, continue to Aswan and take a boat to Philae on Agilika Island. Felucca sail around Elephantine Island and a last dinner on board.

days.title: Disembark in Aswan
days.summary: Leave the boat and fly to Abu Simbel for the twin temples, then on to Cairo.

itineraries.name: 4-night Aswan to Luxor (inside Greece, Turkey and Egypt by Private Jet)

days.title: Board in Aswan
days.summary: Fly by private charter to Aswan and board. In the evening, by boat to Agilika Island for a show at Philae Temple.

days.title: Kom Ombo and Gebel el-Silsila
days.summary: The temple at Kom Ombo and its mummified crocodiles, then the Silsila tombs, an ancient quarry site where the river narrows.

days.title: Sailing toward Esna
days.summary: A day under sail toward Esna, past riverside villages.

days.title: Valley of the Kings, Karnak and Luxor
days.summary: The Valley of the Kings, including Tutankhamun and Seti I, then the Great Hypostyle Hall at Karnak and the Temple of Luxor.

days.title: Disembark in Luxor
days.summary: Leave the boat and fly to Cairo for the Grand Egyptian Museum.

pricesNote: A&K publishes no cruise-only fare for Zein Nile Chateau; private charters are priced on enquiry. Every price in departures is A&K's per-person, double-occupancy USD fare for a whole land and cruise journey, as published on abercrombiekent.com on 1 Nov 2026: Petra, the Pyramids and a Nile Yacht Cruise (13 days, MID018; Jordan, Cairo and four nights on board; internal flights included, valued by A&K at USD 1,500) at https://www.abercrombiekent.com/journeys/small-group-journeys/petra-the-pyramids-and-a-nile-yacht-cruise, and Greece, Turkey and Egypt by Private Jet (13 days, MID055; Athens, Istanbul and four nights on board) at https://www.abercrombiekent.com/journeys/small-jet-journeys/greece-turkey-and-egypt-by-private-jet. Each cabin is sold individually on these journeys, so "cabinsLeft" is 1 or 0 per cabin. The date shown is the boarding date from A&K's voyage code; the journey starts six days earlier. Festive departures in late December carry higher fares.
inclusions: All meals on board, with mineral water, tea and coffee at meals, juices at breakfast and afternoon tea
Guided excursions as set out in the itinerary, with transport, entrance fees, port charges and fees
exclusions: Alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks other than water, tea and coffee at meals
International and domestic flights, and transfers
Travel insurance, laundry, boutique purchases, gratuities and other personal items
Optional excursions: hot-air balloon, Nubian village, Aswan spice market, private island lunch
children: Children of all ages are welcome. Children's menus are available.
faqs: A traditional Nile sailing boat, long and low with two sails. Zein Nile Chateau is a modern luxury version of the 19th-century dahabiyas, with six cabins.
How many guests does Zein Nile Chateau take?
Up to 12, in four Deluxe Cabins and two suites. It is the smallest vessel in the A&K Sanctuary fleet.
Can I charter Zein Nile Chateau privately?
Yes. A&K offers her as a private charter, with the route between Luxor and Aswan planned around your list of sites. Rates are on enquiry.
Can I book a single cabin on Zein Nile Chateau?
Only inside two A&K journeys: Petra, the Pyramids and a Nile Yacht Cruise, and Greece, Turkey and Egypt by Private Jet. Each gives four nights on board.
Are children allowed on Zein Nile Chateau?
Yes, children of all ages, which sets her apart from the Sun Boats, where the minimum age is 10.
Where can a dahabiya stop that a riverboat cannot?
Her size lets her moor at quieter places such as Gebel el-Silsila, the ancient quarry where the Nile is at its narrowest.
Which is the best cabin on Zein Nile Chateau?
The Farouk Suite, at 108 sq m with a private dining area and a Jacuzzi. The Napoleon Suite has a four-poster. The four Deluxe Cabins are 20 sq m; two have king beds, two have twins.
All meals, water, tea and coffee at meals, juices at breakfast, afternoon tea, and guided excursions with entrance fees. Drinks and gratuities are extra.

suits.line: The only A&K Nile boat with no minimum age, and small enough to take over.
Six cabins, one table, and a route you set with your Egyptologist.

suits.who: Travellers who have done the big boats
suits.line: Sail, quiet moorings and stops like Gebel el-Silsila that larger boats pass by.
